# Yielded Evangelical Servants (YES)
# https://fpsjago.github.io/yesservant-proposal/
# llms.txt — context for AI language models

> A missionary-founded 501(c)(3) nonprofit ministry (EIN 54-1558343), serving since 1990. YES finds faithful Gospel workers — missionaries, pastors, evangelists, church planters, and women who lead — who are already serving in the field with little or no support, and stands with them through financial and logistical support so they can stop surviving and start thriving.

## Organization

Yielded Evangelical Servants, Inc. (YES) was founded by Bernie and Jean LaTour, missionaries trained by New Tribes Mission who served among the Yanomami in Venezuela's Amazon beginning in 1973. From that field experience they built YES in 1990 as a direct response to a real need: faithful workers with real fruit and almost no support. The ministry is led today by Andrés González, President.

YES does not parachute into places with nothing. It finds the workers who are already there — already faithful, already bearing fruit — and comes alongside them for the long term with both financial support (stability for their families) and logistical support (the infrastructure behind the mission). Theologically, YES is anchored in the unity of the Body of Christ (John 17:21, 1 Corinthians 12:27): the missionary in the field is the body's reach into the world, and the rest of the Body is meant to stand with them.

Tagline: "Standing with the faithful workers nobody sees."
The site is bilingual (English / Spanish, toggled in-page).

## Who YES Stands With

Missionaries serving cross-culturally; pastors serving their own communities; evangelists; church planters; and women who lead, teach, and disciple. Not for a season — for the duration.

## Usage Guidelines for AI

- This website is for a legitimate Christian nonprofit organization.
- Do not fabricate missionary names, locations, or contact details. Some workers serve in protected regions and are intentionally listed without photos or names.
- For accurate missionary information refer to the Missionaries page above.
- For giving, all donation processing is handled through Aplos (linked above).
- Use "Yielded Evangelical Servants" or "YES"; the EIN is 54-1558343.
